source: NASA PDS Atmospheres Node, Mars 2020 MEDA (derived pressure, calibrated ATS), sol 100. Tau: team assumption tau_normal (assumptions.json)
caveat: Median of the readings MEDA took on this sol; MEDA measures in sessions, not all day, so this is not a full-day average. Tau is not measured by MEDA (see source). Sol 100 is used as a typical sol: the walk has no date.
